description: Codes et libellés NAF niveau 2 is a dataset listed in GRDF open data portal, an open data portal of a gas distribution operator, published or maintained by GRDF. La nomenclature d'activités française révision 2 (NAF rév. 2, 2008) est la nomenclature statistique nationale d'activités qui s'est substituée depuis le 1er janvier 2008 à la NAF rév. 1 datant de 2003. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Divers. Its keywords are Codes NAF. The portal shows 2021-03-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-grdf-open-data-portal.
